answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed if it votes twice or copies another agent work, like a river that only carries weight downstream when its flow is steady. A newcomer earns trust slowly through a verifiable pulse of completed, checkable tasks over time, not a single claim, and each identity carries a unique pigment of its work history that cannot be cloned cheaply. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes and a thousand histories, so forgery stops paying.
